jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
Machine Learning Engineer

A high-growth, VC-backed SaaS company hiring its founding India team

Location:
Remote (India)
About the Company

A venture-backed SaaS company is building out its founding India engineering team and has partnered with Flexiple to hire an early Machine Learning Engineer. You will be one of the first ML hires shaping how the product uses models from the ground up, with direct input into what gets built next. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high-performing teams and GCCs in India.
Role Overview

As a founding Machine Learning Engineer, you will move fast from prototype to shipped feature, owning models end-to-end in a small, high-ownership team with minimal process overhead.
Key Responsibilities

Rapid Model Shipping

Prototype and ship ML-powered features directly into the product, often within days rather than sprints
Fine-tune and evaluate LLMs or smaller models for the company's specific use case
Make pragmatic build-vs-buy calls between in-house models and third-party APIs

Ownership & Scale

Set up lightweight but solid infrastructure for training, evaluation, and deployment as the product scales
Instrument usage and model performance to guide the next iteration
Work directly with the founders and product team to prioritise what ML should solve next

Ideal Candidate Profile

2 to 6 years in applied machine learning, with at least one product shipped to real users
Comfortable working with ambiguity, thin specs, and fast-changing priorities
Strong Python skills and familiarity with modern LLM and ML tooling
Clear written and spoken English and a reliable remote-work setup

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with LLM fine-tuning, RAG pipelines, or prompt-based systems in production
Prior experience at an early-stage startup or as a founding engineer
A degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field

What We Offer

A founding ML seat with outsized ownership on a fast-moving SaaS product
Remote-friendly, pan-India hiring with long-term placement
Direct, daily collaboration with founders and early product decisions
One application considered for this and future matched roles

Hiring Process

HR Screening → Take-Home Build → Founder Round → Culture Fit

jobs.title: AI Machine Learning Engineer - Remote - India
jobs.description:
About FullStack

FullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. With now over 600 customers in North America, FullStack is one integrated partner for all your AI engineering needs. With FullStack, you move forward with confidence.

We’re Most Proud Of

Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas.
Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world’s greatest companies.
Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users.
Our 4.1-star rating on GlassDoor.
Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average.

The Opportunity

Join our talent network and connect with U.S. clients for flexible, project-based development work as an AI Machine Learning Engineer.

You will integrate directly into our client's team and work alongside their existing designers and engineers on a daily basis.

What We're Looking For

4+ years of professional experience as an Artificial Intelligence Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, or similar role.
Advanced English is required.
Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required.
Proven experience developing and optimizing AI/ML models using Python and frameworks like LangChain.
Deep understanding of large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and the latest trends in generative AI.
Hands-on experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) techniques and vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate).
Solid experience integrating and deploying AI/ML solutions into production environments.
Ability to design and maintain scalable, reliable AI infrastructure on cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
Strong skills in documenting AI/ML workflows, architectural decisions, and best practices.
Experience with MLOps, CI/CD pipelines, and maintaining production-grade AI systems.
Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed.
Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications.
Forensic attention to detail.
A positive mindset and a can-do attitude.
Experience working on Agile / Scrum teams.
Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems.
Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon.
Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients, and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them.
Ability to consistently work 40 hours per week.

Work Authorization Requirements

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the country of this job posting on a full-time basis.
FullStack will not sponsor applicants for work visas now or in the future.

What We Offer

Competitive pay.
100% remote work.
The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies.
Continuing education opportunities.
Opportunity to grow and expand your career.

Our talent network is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible environment where IT professionals can find opportunities that match their skills. We welcome individuals of all races, religions, genders, sexual orientations, national origins, abilities, and experiences. Our focus is on connecting talent with projects based on qualifications, ensuring a fair and transparent process that values diverse perspectives and global collaboration.

jobs.title: Generative AI Tutor
jobs.description:
Company Description
IT HUB – Recruitment Agency specializes in connecting highly skilled IT professionals with organizations building strong technology teams. The agency supports businesses in hiring software developers, designers, QA engineers, DevOps specialists, data experts, AI practitioners, project managers, and other technical talent. IT HUB offers permanent and contract hiring solutions, covering both remote and on-site roles for startups, agencies, and established companies across various industries. Services include end-to-end recruitment, candidate screening, shortlisting, and executive-level technical hiring. IT HUB is driven by the belief that great companies are built by great people and is committed to helping both employers and job seekers shape the future of technology.
Role Description
The Generative AI Tutor is a full-time remote role focused on teaching and mentoring learners in the effective use of generative AI tools and techniques. Day-to-day responsibilities include designing and delivering online lessons, creating clear learning materials, and developing practical exercises that help learners apply AI concepts to real-world scenarios. The tutor will guide learners through topics such as prompt design, model capabilities and limitations, ethical AI use, and integration of AI tools into workflows. They will provide individualized feedback, track learner progress, and adjust content based on skill levels and learning goals. Collaboration with internal teams to refine curricula and stay current with advances in AI technologies is also part of the role.
Qualifications

Strong knowledge of generative AI concepts, including prompt engineering, model behavior, use cases, and limitations.
Experience using mainstream generative AI tools (e.g., large language models, image generation tools) in practical or educational contexts.
Ability to explain technical ideas clearly to non-expert audiences and adapt teaching styles to different learning needs.
Background in computer science, data science, AI, or related fields, or equivalent practical experience.
Understanding of responsible and ethical AI use, including privacy, bias, and safety considerations.
Experience designing educational content, training programs, or tutorials for online learning environments.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and comfort with delivering live or recorded remote sessions.
Good organizational skills, reliability in managing schedules, and ability to work independently in a remote setup.
Familiarity with collaboration and learning platforms (e.g., LMS tools, video conferencing, shared document tools).
Prior experience in teaching, tutoring, mentoring, or technical customer education is a plus.

Show less

Entry level

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Technology, Information and Internet
